title: Great tour of the Old...
text: Great tour of the Old Jewish Quarter. Tour guide is very knowledgeable of past history and local history pertaining to the Jewish people that lived in Spain.  The tour was followed by a nice dinner at a local not tourist attraction restaurant.  Highly recommend.
author: David_B

title: A touching piece of Jewish history
text: This was a very valuable tour with an absolutely delightful and knowledgeable guide. Clara, a Sevilla native, gave a very comprehensive review of the Jewish history of Sevilla and Spain. There is very little physical history of the Jews in Sevilla, but she brought their story to life. The tapas and wine portion of our tour gave us an authentic taste of the local cuisine, but more touching was the opportunity to bond with Clara on a personal level.
author: JKleimanAZ

title: Fantastic Tour
text: This was a special tour. The guide (Concha) was amazing as we delved into the Jewish history of Seville and more broadly the history of the city. We then enjoyed a traditional tapas dinner. The group was great and it was a very memorable time.
author: K2296YWstephenb

title: Fascinating and In-depth Seville History Tour with food!
text: Our guide, Hosea, was one of the best we have had, knowledgeable, thorough and great presentation of history in a relatable manner.  We really enjoyed the tapas and restaurant afterwards.  A great opportunity for conversation and connecting.
author: 506frances

title: Jewish quarter walking tour is excellent.
text: From first to last this has been an excellent experience. On this walking tour there were only my wife and myself, and our guide Marta was fabulous. Endless information over the 3 hours of the tour on places we would not have discovered ourselves. Food and drink at the end was lovely and we came away thoroughly satisfied.
